punabbhava.cp: masc. birth in a new existence.

N:
punabbhava：lit．：re-becoming； 'renewed existence'，is a Sutta term for 'rebirth'，which，in later literature mostly is called paṭisandhi （q．v．）．The attainment of Sainthood （Arahatta），implying the end of future rebirths，is often expressed in the words：This is the last birth．Now there is no more a renewed existence!＂ （natthi dāni punabbhavo） （M．26； D．15； Therag．87，339； Sn．502）．- The term is often linked with abhinibbatti （'arising'）．

＂But how，o brother，does it come to renewed existence and arising in the future （āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti）? Because beings，obstructed by ignorance and fettered by craving，find ever fresh delight now here，now there，for this reason there is renewed existence and arising in the future＂ （M．43）．See also S．XII．38．Abhinibbatti also stands sometimes alone in signifying 'rebirth'，e．g．in A．VI，61； X，65．

Cf．，in the 2nd Truth，the adj．ponobhavika，'leading to renewed existence'．

See A．III，76； Sn．163，273，514，733； S．VII，12； X，3．
C: punabbhava：[m．] birth in a new existence．

punabbasuka.p: [ yadicchakanāma ] (pu) CL=10 The monk named Punabbasuka. A monk included in the six Chabbaggiya monks.

punabbhavanibbattaka.p: [ punabbhava + nibbattaka. Thī၌punabbhavanibbattikā ] (ti) CL=10 That which causes again and again - the suffering of life - the lives - the birth in life, That which makes-gives again (occurring) life, That which gives the next life-that which arises for the next life, That which deserves the result of afterlife, That which combines in the making of the afterlife.

punabbhavābhinibbatti.p: [ punabbhava + abhinibbatti ] (thī) CL=10 (1) Being in the next life - in a new life. (2) The new becoming called becoming again. (3) Occurring of the next life in the future. (4) Being again and again - the suffering of life circle that happens again and again.

pn: Punabbasu 01. A young Yakkha (SN.i.210). He became a Sotāpanna (SN-a.i.239). See Punabbasumātā.
Punabbasu 02. One of the Chabbaggiyā. His followers were called Punabbasukā, and, together with the followers of Assaji, they were called Assaji-Punabbasukā (q.v.).

V:
Punabbasu：1．Punabbasu．A young Yakkha （S．i．210）．He became a sotāpanna （SA．i．239）．See Punabbasumātā．

2．Punabbasu． One of the Chabbaggiyā．His followers were called Panabbasukā，and，together with the followers ofAssaji，they were calledAssaji Punabbasukā．

Punabbasu Sutta．Records an incident relating toPunabbasumātā．S．i．210．
